profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

Its website identifies it as a public company trading under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412 and headquarters in Starbase, Texas. No AI products are recorded under its name, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 125.
